audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] reads "Abyssal Dive (R) and Devour (W)". Both slots are wrong: Abyssal Dive is W and Devour is R. The same line then says "he can W-eat you", and whys[4] says "Devour and R" as if they were two abilities.
audit.why: A Zac reading this tracks a 21-second W as if it were the ultimate and treats the ultimate as a short-cooldown spell. Those are opposite play patterns.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive is W (21/20/19/18/17). Devour is R. Fixed in spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kench's sustain is attributed to his passive in three places: spikes[0] "his passive heal negates your W chip damage", spikes[2] "Kench's grey-health passive and heal", early "grey-health heal passive".
audit.why: The passive is An Acquired Taste — bonus damage scaling off his health, plus the stack counter. The grey-health storage is Thick Skin (E). Getting this wrong hides the actual mechanic: Thick Skin banks a percentage of the damage Kench takes and converts it into a shield on cast, on a 3-second cooldown. Chip damage does not wear Kench down, it is the raw material for his shield — so Zac's W poke pattern is exactly the wrong approach, and no line in the entry says so.
audit.corrected: Re-attributed to Thick Skin (E) and rewritten as a sequencing rule: hold damage until Thick Skin is spent, then commit.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (P An Acquired Taste; E Thick Skin, cd 3)

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] reads "Q-stun you when your grey health is up".
audit.why: Grey health is Kench's own stored damage — it has nothing to do with whether Zac can be stunned. Tongue Lash stuns when the target already carries three stacks of An Acquired Taste. As written the line tells Zac to watch a bar that is not his.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (Q Tongue Lash; P An Acquired Taste)

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere". Confirmed — no field gave a wait-for-X-then-Y instruction.
audit.why: This matchup has an unusually clean sequencing rule available: Devour cannot touch Zac until three An Acquired Taste stacks are on him, and Abyssal Dive is Kench's only mobility on a 21s rank-1 cooldown. Both are countable in lane.
audit.corrected: Added three concrete sequences — count stacks before committing (mid), engage once Abyssal Dive is spent (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull), hold burst until Thick Skin is spent (whys[5], spikes[0]).

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Tahm Kench 6 of 7 stages against a 50.53% win rate.
audit.why: 50.53% over 95 games is a coin flip; a 6-1 chart reads as a losing lane.
audit.corrected: Kench keeps levels 1-3, where his Q heal genuinely bullies; 4-5, 6 and first item become Skill; 2+ items stays Zac.

audit.why: The full layer already carries anti-heal as core, which is right — Tongue Lash and Thick Skin both heal. No change needed.
